title: Audit-readiness curation workflow and prioritization scoring for security & compliance asks
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and deliver a repeatable curation workflow that turns incoming enterprise security & compliance requests (SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor questionnaires) into a prioritized, evidence-bundled, SLA-driven workstream. The system should combine automated classification, a compact prioritization score, and an evidence packaging flow that reduces reviewer overhead and supports audit responses and legal reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming requests are automatically classified into categories (control mapping, data residency, encryption, contractual clauses, incident history) with >=85% accuracy on a 500-sample test set.

Each request receives a standardized priority score (0-100) computed from customer tier, regulatory scope, data sensitivity, request complexity, and requested SLA; scores align with manual triage in >80% of cases in pilot.

Evidence bundle generator compiles relevant artifacts (SOC2 summary, network diagram, current DPA, encryption keys policy, past incident reports) into a single downloadable ZIP with links to Confluence and GitHub PRs.
Routing rules forward P0/P1 asks to Security SLT and Solutions Engineering within configured SLOs (24h for P0, 3 business days for P1).
Console shows a per-request audit timeline, ownership, and estimated time-to-complete for customer-facing updates.
Admin UI allows manual override of classification and priority and logs reviewer decisions for future model training.
notes: We will reuse the existing classifier infra from 'Intake NLP' experiment (ENG-49810) but need new control-mapping taxonomy aligned to SOC2 and ISO 27001 controls.

Trade-offs: aggressive automation reduces TTR but increases risk of misclassification for corner regulatory asks (e.g., nested DPAs). We will keep manual review gate for high-impact or ambiguous requests.
We recommend a phased rollout: pilot with 10 enterprise customers, then widen to top 100 accounts before org-wide launch.
Success metrics: median time-to-first-response, % of automated triages accepted by reviewers, reduction in total review hours per request.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Misclassification of high-sensitivity asks could lead to delayed legal/technical responses. Mitigation: manual review gate and alerting for low-confidence classifications.
Risk: Evidence bundle may include outdated artifacts. Mitigation: implement TTL and last-updated checks and show artifact timestamps in bundle manifest.
Risk: Increased workload for Security during pilot. Mitigation: cap pilot volume and provide concierge support for initial customers.
